design-code-rules.title: Footways – Pedestrian zones

design-code-rules.requirement-text: Contributing heritage and non-designated heritage buildings must be retained and may not be extended; other buildings may be extended, or redeveloped with the Council's agreement.
design-code-rules.guidance-text:

AW11 Opportunity sites: Prioritise empty and underused sites; intensification is acceptable only where it meets the area type guidance and passes design review.
